<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/smiles-drawer@2.0.1/dist/smiles-drawer.min.js"></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const molecules = [
        {id: "canvas_Row0", smiles: "C/C=C1/C[C@@H](C)[C@@](C)(O)C(=O)OCC2=CCN3CC[C@@H](OC1=O)[C@@H]23" },
{id: "canvas_Row1", smiles: "C/C=C1\CC(C)C(C)(O)C(=O)OCC2=CCN3CCC(OC1=O)C23" },
{id: "canvas_Row2", smiles: "C/C=C1/CC(C)[C@](C)(O)C(=O)OCC2=CCN3CC[C@H](OC1=O)[C@H]23" },
{id: "canvas_Row3", smiles: "C/C=C1/C[C@H](C)[C@@](C)(O)C(=O)OC/C2=C/CN(C)CC[C@@H](OC1=O)C2=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row4", smiles: "C/C=C1/C[C@@H](C)[C@@](C)(O)C(=O)OC/C2=C/CN(C)CC[C@@H](OC1=O)C2=O" }
    ];
    const drawer = new SmilesDrawer.Drawer({ width: 150, height: 150 });
    molecules.forEach(mol => {
      SmilesDrawer.parse(mol.smiles, function (tree) {
        drawer.draw(tree, mol.id, "light", false);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
